tweets.text: 🇺🇸 Stories of A250 🇺🇸 August 28, 1963. More than 250,000 Americans gathered on the National Mall to demand that the nation live up to its founding promise: that all people are created equal. Standing before the Lincoln Memorial, civil rights leaders called for justice, opportunity, and equal treatment under the law. The March on Washington became a defining moment in the Civil Rights Movement, helping build momentum for historic reforms that would reshape the nation. America's story is not only about preserving freedom. It is also about expanding it. #America250 #CivilRights #MarchOnWashington
